description: Chrome-style tab groups on the VS Code tab bar: named, colored groups you can collapse, drag tabs into, and reorder.
command.addSelectedToNewGroup: Add Selected Tabs to New Group
command.enablePatch: Enable Chrome-style Tab Groups (patches VS Code)
color.color1: Tab group color 1 (chip, group line and active-tab outline). Default: Chrome grey.
color.color2: Tab group color 2 (chip, group line and active-tab outline). Default: Chrome blue.
color.color3: Tab group color 3 (chip, group line and active-tab outline). Default: Chrome red.
color.color4: Tab group color 4 (chip, group line and active-tab outline). Default: Chrome yellow.
color.color5: Tab group color 5 (chip, group line and active-tab outline). Default: Chrome green.
color.color6: Tab group color 6 (chip, group line and active-tab outline). Default: Chrome pink.
color.color7: Tab group color 7 (chip, group line and active-tab outline). Default: Chrome purple.
color.color8: Tab group color 8 (chip, group line and active-tab outline). Default: Chrome cyan.
color.color9: Tab group color 9 (chip, group line and active-tab outline). Default: Chrome orange.
color.ungroupDropLine: Drop line shown while dragging a tab, when releasing it would take the tab out of its group.
setting.tabBar.activeTabOutline: Draw Chrome's rounded outline, in the group color, around the active tab of a group on the tab bar. When off, the active tab keeps VS Code's own style and the group line runs under it.
setting.tabBar.chipMaxWidth: The widest a group chip on the tab bar can get, in pixels (40 to 400). A longer group name ends in ….
setting.tabBar.chipTabCount: Show how many tabs a group has on its chip on the tab bar.
setting.keyboard.showGroupShortcuts: While you hold the modifier keys of **Go to Group 1…9** (Alt on Windows), each group chip on the tab bar shows its key, like `Alt+1`. Change the keys in Keyboard Shortcuts.
setting.keyboard.changeKeys: Change the keys of Tab Groups (go to group, next and previous group, collapse, new group and more) in [Keyboard Shortcuts](command:workbench.action.openGlobalKeybindings?%5B%22%40ext%3AJJLIM00.tabpalette%22%5D).
setting.groupColors.color1: Default: grey (`#DADCE0` in dark themes, `#5F6368` in light themes).
setting.groupColors.color2: Default: blue (`#8AB4F8` in dark themes, `#1A73E8` in light themes).
setting.groupColors.color3: Default: red (`#F28B82` in dark themes, `#D93025` in light themes).
setting.groupColors.color4: Default: yellow (`#FDD663` in dark themes, `#E37400` in light themes).
setting.groupColors.color5: Default: green (`#81C995` in dark themes, `#1E8E3E` in light themes).
setting.groupColors.color6: Default: pink (`#FF8BCB` in dark themes, `#D01884` in light themes).
setting.groupColors.color7: Default: purple (`#C58AF9` in dark themes, `#9334E6` in light themes).
setting.groupColors.color8: Default: cyan (`#78D9EC` in dark themes, `#007B83` in light themes).
setting.groupColors.color9: Default: orange (`#FCAD70` in dark themes, `#C26401` in light themes).
setting.ungroupDropLineColor: The drop line while dragging a tab, when releasing it would take the tab out of its group. Default: red (`#F14C4C` in dark themes, `#E51400` in light themes).
